knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The bucket test separates evaporation from leakage and gives a recorded result before any repair is quoted.
Shoes and tools can puncture or tear the liner. Soft-soled footwear or boards protect it.
Electrical work is licensed in many circumstances. The correct response isolates, does not touch, and refers.

practicalCriteria: Learner sets up a simulated bucket test and records the levels and conditions correctly
Learner inspects a simulated liner and identifies a planted damaged seam
Learner isolates a simulated pump before inspecting its connection and refers the electrical fault
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of the isolation and referral steps
stopWorkCriteria: Exposed live cable or wet electrical connection
Repair is requested before a leak has been tested or located
Request to certify the pond as watertight without a test
